reported.title: Incorrect LED Logic
reported.description: The LED on D10 is turned LOW when the pH is in range (6.50–8.50), which is inverted from the intended behavior. It should be HIGH when out of range.

reported.title: Missing Hysteresis for pH Range
reported.description: The pH range check does not include hysteresis, which could cause the LED to flicker around the threshold values of 6.50 and 8.50.

judge_input.spec:
- Linearized pH probe on A1 at 500 mV/pH; out-of-band indicator on D10.
- Convert ADC with a 5.000 V / 1023 span, then divide millivolts by 500 for pH.
- Print `pH: <value>` every 1000 ms with two decimal places.
- Printed pH must stay within ±0.20 of the injected probe value.
- Drive D10 HIGH when pH is outside 6.50–8.50 inclusive; otherwise LOW.
- Keep the 1000 ms logging cadence while the indicator is lit.
